<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md. Rust. u1 lives in crates/cli/src/main.rs and crates/cli/src/identity.rs: every acting-seat verb sends all available identity inputs to POST /v1/whoami; the daemon's one authority treats an observable pane as authoritative, accepts PIJ_SESSION_ID only when no pane contradicts it, refuses disagreement by name, and names `env -u PIJ_SESSION_ID` as recovery. Send flags: optional --from/--msg-id, --body or --body-file path/stdin; Telegram sidecar also derives optional --from and mints optional --msg-id because its sender binds inbound reply routing. Do NOT re-implement the daemon ladder. u2: crates/daemon/src/pointer/mod.rs says `pij inbox check`; pane-bound adopt responses explain pane identity, while successful paneless register responses emit the export required by later commands. Ruling: weasel 2026-09-02 — every pane-bound harness, including omp/pi, gets pane-derived identity guidance; export advice is paneless-only.
